  • Related Packages

    Description
    com.github.crittscott.somebuckets
     
  • Class
    Description
    ClientDiagnostics
    The client /sb operator diagnostics.
    ClientModelTypes
    Ids of the item-definition types Some Buckets adds: the FluidBucketModel and MobBucketModel item models, the JunkContentsRenderer special renderer, and the MobEggColors.Tint tint source.
    ClientPlatform
    The client's loader seam: the loader's fluid rendering facts, plus the config directory and loader name the diagnostic reports need.
    ClientPlatform.ColorReloadListener
    Client resource reload listener each loader registers: reads Mob Bucket palette overrides in background preparation, then, on the game thread, resets sampled egg palettes and averages every source fluid's still texture so drawing a bucket bar never reads a file.
    ClientPlatform.FluidFacts
    Loader-resolved rendering facts for a stored fluid.
    ClientPlatform.FluidFactsSource
    Resolves a stored fluid's rendering facts through the loader's client fluid API.
    FluidBucketModel
    Item model for Big, Huge, and Source Buckets, registered as somebuckets:fluid_bucket.
    FluidBucketModel.Look
    The fluid layer's still sprite, stack-aware ARGB tint, and emissiveness.
    FluidBucketModel.Unbaked
    Item-definition form: {"type": "somebuckets:fluid_bucket", "model": <vessel model>}.
    FluidMaskGeometry
    Item-model quads for content layers: the fluid layer retextures the content mask model's generated quads, and the Junk Bucket cover builds its rectangles by hand because they are derived from the opening mask when the renderer bakes, not from a model.
    FluidMaskGeometry.Face
    One outward-facing quad in normalized item-model coordinates.
    JunkContentsRenderer
    Special item renderer for the Junk Bucket's stored stacks, registered as somebuckets:junk_contents.
    JunkContentsRenderer.Frame
    Independently extracted child models and placements, retained through deferred submission.
    JunkContentsRenderer.Unbaked
    Item-definition form: {"type": "somebuckets:junk_contents", "texture": <vessel sprite for the cover>}.
    MobBucketModel
    Includes the completed palette in GUI model identity so a pending bucket redraws when ready.
    MobBucketModel.Unbaked
    The bucket vessel and its two tinted overlays use the normal block-model renderer.
    MobEggColors
    Reload-scoped Mob Bucket palettes, sampled lazily from rendered spawn eggs on the client.
    MobEggColors.ReportSamples
    Client-thread snapshot for a diagnostic sweep; its pixel arrays are read-only.
    MobEggColors.Sample
    Straight-alpha, top-to-bottom ARGB thumbnail and either its palette or a failure explanation.
    MobEggColors.Tint
    The two overlay colors of the captured mob, with gray used while a sample is pending or absent.
